references.name: Sun reference
references.basis: Adopted solar M_V = +4.81 from Willmer (2018), in the Vega magnitude system. The Sun example starts at the standard distance of 10 pc.

references.name: Sirius
references.basis: HIP 32349: Johnson V = −1.44; parallax = 379.21 ± 1.58 mas in the ESA 1997 catalogue. M_V is inferred from these inputs assuming negligible extinction.

references.name: Vega
references.basis: HIP 91262: Johnson V = +0.03; parallax = 128.93 ± 0.55 mas in the ESA 1997 catalogue. M_V is inferred from these inputs assuming negligible extinction.

assumptions: Steady nearby point source; Euclidean inverse-square dilution.
Inferred catalogue M_V assumes negligible extinction for these nearby examples.
Foreground A_V is a separately chosen V-band dimming, not a fixed per-distance dust rate.
Quoted parallax errors are shown; measurement and calibration uncertainty are not propagated.
V-band luminosity ratios compare one filter and do not replace bolometric luminosity.
